operations.name: EMSIActiveEmojis
EMSIAdminApplicationDetail
operations.body:
query EMSIAdminApplicationDetail($id: ID!) {
	adminApplicationDetail(id: $id) {
		id
		applicant {
			id
			username
			displayName
			city
			membershipState
			applicationState
			roleLabels
			visibility {
				field
				state
				canReveal
				reasonRequired
				auditAction
			}
		}
		state
		city
		submittedAt
		updatedAt
		nextActionOwner
		shortMotivationPreview
		answers {
			key
			label
			value
			valueType
			group
			displayOrder
			required
			sensitive
		}
		answerGroups {
			group
			answers {
				key
				label
				value
				valueType
				group
				displayOrder
				required
				sensitive
			}
		}
		applicantCopy
		internalNotes {
			body
			createdAt
		}
		applicantMessages {
			body
			createdAt
		}
		decisionHistory {
			id
			actorUserID
			actorUsername
			action
			targetType
			targetID
			previousState
			newState
			reason
			createdAt
		}
		audit {
			id
			actorUserID
			actorUsername
			action
			targetType
			targetID
			previousState
			newState
			reason
			createdAt
		}
		allowedActions {
			action
			label
			riskLevel
			requiresReason
			requiresUserVisibleMessage
			createsProposal
			requiresConfirmation
			disabledReason
		}
	}
}

			id
			actorUserID
			actorUsername
			action
			targetType
			targetID
			previousState
			newState
			reason
			createdAt
		}
		allowedActions {
			action
			label
			riskLevel
			requiresReason
			requiresUserVisibleMessage
			createsProposal
			requiresConfirmation
			disabledReason

}

operations.name: EMSIChannelPosts

query EMSIChannelPosts($channelID: ID!, $limit: Int = 30, $cursor: String) {
	channelPosts(channelID: $channelID, limit: $limit, cursor: $cursor) {
		posts {
			id
			legacyPostID
			channelID
			parentPostID
			author {
				id
				legacyUserID
				username
				usernameColor
				pictureURL
			}
			content
			attachmentURL
			thumbnailURL
			blurhash
			width
			height
			replyCount
			replyPreview {
				id
				legacyPostID
				channelID
				parentPostID
				author {
					id
					legacyUserID
					username
					usernameColor
					pictureURL
				}
				content
				attachmentURL
				thumbnailURL
				blurhash
				width
				height
				replyCount
				reactionSummary {
					emojiID
					key
					unified
					url
					count
					updatedAt
				}
				createdAt
				updatedAt
			}
			reactionSummary {
				emojiID
				key
				unified
				url
				count
				updatedAt
			}
			createdAt
			updatedAt
		}
		nextCursor
	}
}

operations.name: EMSIHomeFeed
operations.body:
query EMSIHomeFeed($mode: HomeFeedMode = FOR_YOU, $cursor: String) {
	homeFeed(mode: $mode, cursor: $cursor) {
		items {
			type
			id
			reason {
				key
				args
				text
				systemImage
			}
			controls
			trackingToken
			post {
				id
				channelID
				channelName
				author {
					id
					fullName
					city
					avatarURL
				}
				body
				createdAt
				likeCount
				replyCount
				isLiked
				mediaURL
				mediaKind
				thumbnailURL
				blurhash
				width
				height
			}
			event {
				id
				title
				summary
				channelID
				channelName
				city
				venue
				date
				capacity
				joinedCount
				waitingCount
				status
				participation
				tags
				host {
					id
					fullName
					city
					avatarURL
				}
			}
			liveRoom {
				id
				channelID
				title
				subtitle
				participantCount
				participants {
					id
					fullName
					city
					avatarURL
				}
			}
			channelPulse {
				channelID
				channelName
				accentName
				summary
				newPostCount
				previews {
					id
					authorName
					snippet
				}
			}
			friendActivity {
				id
				actor {
					id
					fullName
					city
					avatarURL
				}
				text
				systemImage
				targetID
			}
		}
		nextCursor
		refreshCursor
		generatedAt
	}
}
